errors.algo-same-speed: Thinks the two searches take the same time

errors.eq-sign-add-all: Adds every number in the statement

errors.trig-sin-cos-swapped: Swaps the exact values of sine and cosine

errors.algo-sorted-in-one-pass: Expects bubble sort to finish in one pass

errors.ord-power-scope: Applies the power to the wrong part (e.g. squares the product instead of the base)

errors.sigma-last-term-only: Gives the last term instead of the sum
errors.seq-additive: Treats a multiplicative recurrence as additive
errors.cs-constant-not-adjusted: Keeps the original constant after completing the square
errors.prob-both: Thinks events can be both mutually exclusive and independent here

errors.frac-num-only: Combines numerators and leaves the denominator unchanged, without a common denominator

errors.deriv-power-not-reduced: Multiplies by the power but does not reduce it
